stem: (Select TWO.) Hallowmere Systems reviews a colleague's `required_providers` block and needs to know precisely which future releases each constraint would allow.

choices.text: `>= 3.2.0` allows only version 3.2.0 and nothing newer.
`!= 3.2.0` allows every release except exactly version 3.2.0.
`= 3.2.0` allows 3.2.0 and any later patch release such as 3.2.1.
`~> 3.2.0` allows Terraform to install 3.2.1 or 3.2.9, but not 3.3.0.

rationale: `!=` excludes only the one named exact version and allows everything else, matching the first key. `~>` allows only the right-most component to increment, so `~> 3.2.0` allows 3.2.1 or 3.2.9 but not 3.3.0, matching the second key. `>= 3.2.0` allows 3.2.0 and everything greater, not only that one version. `= 3.2.0` allows only that exact version and blocks later patch releases too. `<= 3.2.0` includes 3.2.0 itself along with everything below it, so it does not exclude 3.2.0.
